common_premise: FixedR valid selected AI user/target/wrapper/handler context. Only exact required config consumers are new joins; actual producer constants/sourcefacts reused. Scores/estimates distinct from ordinary battle effects. No gameplay/native execution and no extra sourceFULL/context/vote. All recursively called callbacks not expressly received remain OPEN.

facts.meaning: Five ItemRanking callbacks independently bind Aguav→SpDef,Figy→Attack,Iapapa→Defense,Mago→Speed,Wiki→SpAtk. Each adds2 to passed score atMECH==7, subtracts3 at<=6, otherwise keeps generation contribution unchanged. At high skill only, disliked nature decreasing that mappedstat subtracts2. No HP recovery/berry consumption/confusion occurs in these ranking callbacks.
facts.control: wants_item normalizes item nil→NONE/id, chooses first baseline table rating, then only medium_skill? dispatches modification; later Fling/Acrobatics adjustments independent. A high-skill predicate inside callback is not an unconditional caller guarantee.
facts.failure_prefix: Ranking returns a localscore; nature/callback can raise before return. Dispatcher may have earlier effects; no state rollback or proof the selected item is ever actually held/eaten.
facts.open: Full baseline ratings/dispatcher lookup/nature values and item-effect callers remain separately scoped; no allItems actual use acceptance.

False returns10 when any specialmove exists, else6 forSpDef valuation. This only chooses AI preference; actual item damage/stat effect is another callback.
facts.control: Current derivedflag selects true under relevant default; helper checks current species predicates and move collection, not item description or Itemflag. No party save/object equip here.
facts.failure_prefix: Predicate callbacks may fail before result; no native stat/item writes directly. Complete wrapper context may already have effects outside ranking.
facts.open: Complete species/move/skill predicates and actual SoulDew battle application remain independent.

facts.meaning: Conditional gem ItemRanking matches exact18 gemIDs. It adds2 atMECH<=5 before matching gem→type dictionary and returns modifiedscore only when battler has damagingmove of mappedtype, else0. It neither setsGemConsumed nor scales actualdamage.
facts.control: Conditional registration is distinct from a guaranteed handler route when an explicit handler wins. Actual current ID/registry availability are separate from list membership.
facts.failure_prefix: Score locallychanges before later predicate failure; no gem consumed or persistent write directly. No callback transaction.
facts.open: Full ranking dispatch ordering and actual gem effect/consumption remain separate, with own earlier BS-F07 providing finite actual multiplier request.

facts.meaning: rough_end_of_round_damage accumulates an estimate, not appliedHP. Burn under indirectdamage uses totalHP/16 atMECH>=7 else/8; Heatproof halves via round, min1. Trapping requires duration>1+indirectdamage; regular amount/8 at>=6 else/16, changed to/6 versus/8 when referenced trapping-user wrapper has activeBindingBand. PerishSong==1 returns999999 before laterBadDreams/StickyBarb additions.
facts.control: Complete method also estimates weather/healing/leech/poison/etc locally. No claim estimate reproduces actual EOR sequence or abilityActive for every branch; source ability_id switch is kept as written. Invalid trapping source index may fail; no normalization.
facts.failure_prefix: Read/query callbacks may have their own mutations or raise. Local accumulatedret disappears on exception; no wrapper HP write or automatic state restore. Earlier callback effects not rolled back.
facts.open: Actual EOR writers/ability/item behavior and native distribution remain independently accepted named facts; estimate is not execution evidence.

facts.meaning: can_become_trapped? rejects fainted, active CertainSwitching ability/item, Ghost+MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS, alreadytrapped, or opposing active trapping ability/item. True means not currently trapped and susceptible to future trapping, unlike actual pbCanSwitchOut? whose certain-switch path returnstrue.
facts.control: Type shortcut is negative AI susceptibility, not actual switch registration; separate can_switch_lax? rejectswild then searches pbCanSwitchIn?.
facts.failure_prefix: Callbacks can perform effects/raise before returned predicate. No party swap or direct save in these methods; no transaction.
facts.open: Full trapping callbacks/AI selection and party candidate data remain independently scoped.

facts.meaning: Consuming-item AI score for five confusionberries uses divisor8 throughgen6,2 gen7,3 >=8; HP above totalHP*(1-1/divisor) gets-6 else+6. Berry+Ripen scales score3/2. Highskill disliked mappednature subtracts3 only when actual pbCanConfuseSelf?(false). At tail anynegative becomes0 unless try_preserving_item true.
facts.control: This score does not heal/consume/confuse. Other item cases in the complete method have separate exact predicates; no claim every case is faithful actual battle effect. Forcedpreserve exposes negative preference rather than proving failure.
facts.failure_prefix: Real predicate callbacks can raise or mutate before score returns; local score has no persistent writer itself. No cleanup/rollback guarantee for nested effects.
facts.open: All other item-specific actual effects/caller skill gates and native outcome remain separate.

facts.meaning: rough_damage uses fixed-damage earlyreturn before multiplier config. Other paths apply activeNormalize1.2 onlyMECH>=7; activeParentalBond power1.25 >=7 else1.5; mediumskill matching Electric/Grassy/Psychic terrain1.3 >=8 else1.5 only when actualuser affected, MistyDragon half requires targetaffected. Highskill/internal/player-ownedtarget physical/special badge thresholds add defense1.1. Estimatedcritical uses NEW_CRITICAL true1.5 else2. It floors/rounds/clamps intermediates then nonlethal cap; no random variance is added.
facts.control: Skill and effectiveability gates are perbranch; no general all-config effect across all moves. base_power/critical/getAttack/getDefense and actual Ability/Item callbacks are called, including real move OnStartUse for two category functions. Snapshot/saved flags are not wholesale isolated AI data.
facts.failure_prefix: set_up writes realmove.calcType then ORs battle.moldBreaker. rough damage callbacks can mutate real effects. GemConsumed clear occurs after user item damagecallback returns; callback failure skips clear. No ensure or whole state rollback. Later type/rounding failure can retain earlier callback effects.
facts.open: All callback implementations/base_power/critical getters and actual battle damage order are independent. Source read of entire necessary method does not approve all unselected effects.

facts.meaning: rough_accuracy OHKO branch returns max(baseAccuracy+leveldiff,0), with OHKOIce nonIce minus10; it precedes usual always-hit checks. Mediumskill Telekinesis gives100; minimized target+trampling gives100 onlyMECH>=6. Baseaccuracy0 gives100. apply modifiers invokes actual ability/item callbacks and then mediumskill BadPoisonTarget+statusMove+Poisonuser+MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS sets base_accuracy0, later mapped to100. Otherwise returned ratio need not clamp100.
facts.control: Accuracy getter invokes real pbBaseAccuracy only at mediumskill, otherwise rawaccuracy. Thus AI estimate gates/order differ from true hit check; no actual RNG draw or appliedhit here.
facts.failure_prefix: Callbacks and lazy queries can mutate/raise; modifier scratch can partly update before failure. No ensure restoring real battler/ability state. Early100 returns bypass later modifiers but not earlier reads.
facts.open: Actual OHKO restrictions/true hit RNG and full ability/item modifier implementations remain independently scoped; no new target-gate finding or alias inference.

facts.meaning: Additional-effect score returns0 for addlEffect0, then-999 for userSheerForce, then-999 for opposing-index ShieldDust unlessMoldBreaker. Otherwise+5 only addlEffect<100 and (MECH>=6 or function!=EffectDependsOnEnvironment) and SereneGrace or Rainbow. Final0 means unchangedscore, not absenceofactualeffect.
facts.control: Env effect beforegen6 excludes this preference boost only; nonEnv remains eligible. No extra-effect execution/random chance applied by this method.
